name: Hard bop
summary: Bebop's successor in the mid 1950s: the Clifford Brown-Max Roach quintet and Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers, with arranged heads, band figures for the drums to set up, and waltzes and odd meters as well as 4/4.

drum_characteristics.feel: Swing, from medium to very fast
hallmarks: bass drum played through and accented
melodic drum solos in the form
